title: FitGirl DirectLink Extractor: Stopping the 40-Part Download Nightmare
description: FuckingFast Scraper is a serverless utility to bypass host redirect chains, resolve up to 30 URLs in parallel, and batch extract direct links.

title: FitGirl Repacks Archive Scanner: A Faster Way to Search and Explore the Archive
description: FitGirl Repacks Archive Scanner is a web-based tool that scans archive pages and turns them into a searchable database you can explore in real time, running entirely on Cloudflare Workers.

title: I Made 3rd Grade Result Website — A Faster Way to Search RSSB Results Without Scrolling PDFs
description: This project turns the RSSB 3rd Grade result PDF into a fast and simple web-based search tool, allowing candidates to search by name and instantly view detailed results.

title: How I Built an AI-Ready Project Bundler — Turning Massive Codebases into LLM-Friendly Packages
description: TreeBundle is a browser-based tool that gathers source code and documents from multiple sources, organizes them into a structured project bundle, and prepares them for AI analysis, running entirely in the browser.

title: How I Built a Multi-Platform, Privacy-First Tool to Strip Trackable Links and Metadata from PDFs
description: Every time we share a PDF document, we share more data than we realize. I built ClearLink-PDF to strip away trackable hyperlinks, structural bookmarks, and sensitive system metadata entirely from documents, running 100% offline.

title: My Tools Directory: Direct Access to All Built Projects
description: A centralized directory providing quick, direct access to the live demos, GitHub repositories, and original stories of all digital tools I have built, including TreeBundle, ClearLink-PDF, and more.
